preconditions.description: The length of the original string s must be between 1 and 500000.
The length of the desired string k must be between 1 and 500000.
The length of the string s must be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length of exactly k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == min(s[i:] + s[i:] * (k // len(s[i:])) + s[i:][:k % len(s[i:])] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output string must be the lexicographically smallest string of length k that can be obtained by performing the allowed operations on s.
